name: name
description: (Required) The name of the Scope Connection. The name must be between 1 and 64 characters, and can contain letters, numbers, underscores, periods, and hyphens. The name must start with a letter or a number, and end with a letter, a number, or an underscore.

name: network_manager_id
description: (Required) The ID of the Network Manager to which this Scope Connection belongs.

name: resource_id
description: (Required) The ID of the Subscription or Management Group to which the Network Manager will connect.

name: tenant_id
description: (Required) The tenant ID of the Subscription or Management Group to which the Network Manager will connect.

name: description
description: (Optional) The description of the Scope Connection.
